mathematical_meanings: Left image: The shading designates the entire area inside the equilateral triangle. Right image: The shading highlights the 27° central angle between the radii.
Rationales: The feature selects a geometric area in the left image and highlights the angle between two rays in the right image. The lavender triangle with three 2 in side labels. The lavender wedge at the right-hand junction of the two radii.
